overall_reason: The idea is 'show which libraries are in sync': two rows with their own states, plus a detached 'All files synced' confirmation.

score.reason: T-ONE-SENTENCE and T-SIGNATURE pass for a small Operate panel; T-REMOVE-DEVICE shows the toast repeats the rows, and T-RIVAL-NAME holds because nothing in it is specific to one product.

findings.title: App screens disappear into the task
findings.where: toast under the 'Workspace sync' card, 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png the toast 'All files synced' sits about 15 px below the card and restates 'Up to date' and '2 min ago' from the rows.
findings.before: A confirmation toast that repeats the rows' status.
findings.after: Keep the toast only if it reports an event the rows do not show, for example which library just finished syncing.
findings.why: Two signals for one fact add reading without adding information.

strengths: Each row pairs a library with its own state, the working object of a sync panel.
The toast is detached from the card with clear space, so the two objects read separately.
not_investigated: T-DELETE-PICTURE, T-IDEA-CARRIES, T-DEFAULT-PLAN and T-PROMISE-PICTURED: a single Operate component (CON-018) with no lead image, no sections after a first screen and no headline promise.
